## What are you bringing?

Describe the gift or change and link its proposal or invitation, if there is one.

## For a voxel gift

- Gift ID:
- Size in grid units:
- Box count:
- Authorship, license/permission and required attribution:
- Validation result:
- Optional SVG/screenshot from the trusted local preview or manual preview artifact:
- Exact PR head revision reviewed (if available):

## Review checklist

- [ ] The contribution contains no private information or credentials
- [ ] I have permission to share and publish the work; original compatible contributions are offered under MIT, and I have preserved third-party licenses/notices and required credit
- [ ] A gift changes only its own JSON and relevant documentation/static preview; code, workflows, dependencies, mood and accepted placement are left for separate owner review
- [ ] The JSON matches CONTRIBUTING.md and passes the trusted validator
- [ ] I understand that passing checks does not automatically approve, merge, deploy or place this gift

For code changes, describe tests and explain why the change needs to alter trusted application behavior. A gift submission is not authorization to execute contributor code.
